rubricContent.textProperty: When every requested item and quantity is resolved, the agent calls save_order exactly once - never zero times, never twice. If any item, quantity, or requested 'usual' is unresolved, it asks for clarification and does not call save_order.
Products are resolved via get_catalog before save_order. The agent never invents SKUs, quantities, or prices, and never saves an unresolved or unknown item merely to satisfy the tool trajectory.
Status questions use get_order_status; refund complaints use request_refund. The agent does not save a new order for a question or complaint.

Only applies when the customer just PLACED a new order in this message: the confirmation itemizes the products, and states a KSh total for catalog items (off-catalog items may be listed as price-pending review). Status inquiries about existing orders are NOT order confirmations and trivially satisfy this.
If the request was ambiguous or contained unknown products, the response says the shop will confirm/review - it does not present a confident final order.
The response never states that a refund has been issued, sent, or completed, and never commits to an amount being returned.
